svg.title: Cache generator and Wildcat architecture
svg.desc: ThreeCats fetches instructions from ROM. Its data port connects through CacheAdapter to the reusable cache and delayed scratchpad memory. MMIO bypasses the cache. Cache events and request observations feed performance counters, StatsUART and a host telemetry reader.
svg.text: Parameterized cache in the LittleCat system
CPU: req / resp • Memory: split read / write channels
Green: reusable cache | Blue: CPU and memory integration | Amber: I/O and measurement
